parent_objective: run bounded replay smoke over source-diverse pressure preflight-pass candidates
blocked_by: bounded replay has not yet been run on source-diverse pressure preflight-pass candidates
supersedes: preflight-only evidence as outcome-sensitive replay evidence

public_gates: M1481 must run bounded replay with --candidate-step-column source_step
M1481 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1481 must report actual replay rows history positives control positives normal failures and source diversity
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat one public replay smoke as paper-level evidence
do not claim level3 self-identification from one public replay smoke

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs bounded replay smoke over source-diverse pressure preflight-pass candidates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: bounded replay smoke only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if candidate_step_column is not source_step
stop if training_started or ppo_used or promoted is true
fallback_plan: route to replay result audit if smoke completes
route to replay schema audit if smoke aborts before actual replay rows
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1480 admits source-diverse pressure bounded replay smoke

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up replay result audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: replay smoke completed or failed clearly
actual replay rows and outcome counts are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1481 can only make bounded public replay claims; one smoke cannot establish level3 self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: normal history versus selected history variants in bounded replay
reset and zero-current controls emitted by replay probe
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no source-diverse history positives appear, audit source/replay design rather than weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: bounded replay smoke result and row counts
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded replay smoke over M1479 source-diverse pressure candidates can test whether proposal/preflight diversity transfers to outcome-sensitive replay rows.
failure_criteria: run starts training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change

commands.name: source_diverse_pressure_bounded_replay_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.bounded_relocation_replay_probe --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m1419_warmup_gate_invasiveness_retune_source_wave.json --candidate-rows runs/m1479_source_diverse_pressure_preflight_smoke/selected_candidate_rows.csv --geometry-aware-selector --max-candidate-rows 96 --per-capability-pair-cap 16 --per-seed-cap 24 --per-reveal-bucket-cap 12 --per-variant-cap 48 --history-length 56 --recent-window-length 4 --max-continuation-steps 48 --min-margin-gap 0.02 --min-sequence-action-l2 0.025 --min-source-body-x 4.0 --candidate-step-column source_step --device cpu --run-dir runs/m1481_source_diverse_pressure_bounded_replay_smoke

decision_rule: M1481 passes if source-diverse pressure bounded replay smoke completes and records actual replay rows without training or promotion.
